purpose: Teach: 高貴/光源/放電/腹部/劣悪/乳房/置換/有人

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、高貴な美術品の窃盗を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police handle art theft cases like this one, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Lean forward slightly. Warm tone seeking confirmation. Pause before the final tag, inviting agreement rather than interrogating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、街灯の光源異常も把握されますね
lines.en: Yes, and we also monitor things like streetlight malfunctions in the area.
lines.style: Measured, professional but approachable. Steady eye contact. Matter-of-fact delivery—listing routine procedure without grandstanding. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、放電事故での被害者を、警察、医療連携で対応されますね
lines.en: In this case with the discharge accident victim, the police coordinate with medical teams, right?
lines.style: Slightly uncertain, checking his understanding. Soft, almost deferential tone. Pauses before 'medical teams' as if making sure he has the terminology right.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、腹部殴打事件の鑑識も担当します
lines.en: That's correct. We also handle the forensic work on assault cases like this one.
lines.style: Clear and professional. Declarative—not uncertain. Slight weight on 'forensic work' showing competence. Calm, direct. The voice of someone explaining their responsibility without apology.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、劣悪な労働環境での違反を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And labor violations in unsafe working conditions—those fall under police investigation too?
lines.style: Gentle questioning, not accusatory. Slight rise at the end showing genuine uncertainty. Respectful of the officer's domain. A little tentative, as if worried he might be overstepping.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、乳房関連の医療事故も担当します
lines.en: We do handle those matters. Medical incidents related to workplace safety are part of our purview as well.
lines.style: Steady, professional. No hesitation. Spoken with quiet confidence. The kind of procedural listing that shows experience without needing to prove it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、置換型DNA改ざんを、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So DNA tampering cases—the police investigate those, correct?
lines.style: Careful, almost academic in tone. Slow pace. Slight uncertainty creeping in at the edges. Like he's pushing into territory he's less sure about but still respecting the officer's expertise.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、有人潜水艇の事故も対応されますね
lines.en: We do. Submarine accidents and similar incidents fall under our response protocols as well.
lines.style: Warm and grounded. Closer to the listener, more personal than the previous line. Still professional but with a thread of gentleness. The officer reassuring rather than just informing.
